name: Mall maj9 piano-pad
desc: Lush ireal-voiced maj9/13 changes in F lydian (F^9 / G13 / Am9 / Dm9 — the G major over F is the lydian glow) blending a clip(1) acoustic piano comp against a soft sawtooth pad on opposite-phase filter breaths. Sparse holds the changes; full comps a syncopated struct; peak adds an octave-shimmer canon and a phrase-end nudge. Sunset food-court haze.

code.full: stack(chord("<F^9 G13 Am9 Dm9>").dict('ireal').voicing().s("piano").clip(1).struct("x ~ [~ x] ~").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).gain(${gain}), chord("<F^9 G13 Am9 Dm9>").dict('ireal').voicing().s("sawtooth").attack(.5).decay(.3).sustain(.7).release(.7).lpf(cosine.range(${pad}*.6,${pad}).slow(24)).lpq(2).gain(${gain}*.5)).room(${room}).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: stack(chord("<F^9 G13 Am9 Dm9>").dict('ireal').voicing().s("piano").clip(1).struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").off(1/8,x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.35)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(${gain}), chord("<F^9 G13 Am9 Dm9>").dict('ireal').voicing().s("sawtooth").attack(.35).decay(.4).sustain(.8).release(.6).lpf(cosine.range(${pad}*.7,${pad}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(2).gain(${gain}*.55)).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.late(.02)).orbit(4).play()
